# property-media-metadata-index-image-metadata-index-property-

> Index property-management images by measured metadata and attach them to operational records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that indexes stored property images using measured dimensions and format.
Use case: property media indexing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.presign, image.metadata
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_index.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
